description: Decide how services communicate in a Löwy-style layered architecture: direct synchronous calls, queued calls, Pub/Sub events, or a full Message Bus. Use when the user needs to choose communication patterns between services, implement the "Message Is the Application" pattern, design workflow Managers, or decide whether a Message Bus is justified. Trigger on: "message bus", "how should services communicate", "pub/sub", "queued calls", "event-driven", "workflow manager", "Message Is the Application", "async vs sync", "service wiring", or any question about how Clients reach Managers or how Managers coordinate with each other.
